title: R142 批次一 · 5 城 20 院首批数据（5/6 选 5 · 留南通到下一批）
scope_note: 选取 R142-candidates.md 批次一中的 5 城（郑州/福州/海口/温州/南宁），南通因国际医疗量较小留至下一批。每家医院均已通过 web_search 找到公开官网 URL 核验全称/地址/电话；JCI 认证状态、英文科室列表、费用区间等关键字段 verified=false 待核验。

cities.name: Zhengzhou
cities.intro: Capital of Henan province and a major medical center in central China. Known for traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) combined with modern oncology and cardiovascular surgery. Hosts national TCM international cooperation exchange bases.

cities.name: Fuzhou
cities.intro: Capital of Fujian province, a regional medical hub serving southeastern China. Hosts the Fujian Medical University hospital network with strong neuroscience and hepatobiliary surgery programs. Several thousand overseas Chinese from Southeast Asia trace family ties to Fuzhou.

cities.name: Haikou
cities.intro: Capital of Hainan province and the principal city of the Hainan Free Trade Port. Boasts a tropical climate suited to rehabilitation, a Boao medical tourism pilot zone, and growing international patient services including dedicated International (VIP) Clinics and bilingual coordination.

cities.name: Wenzhou
cities.intro: A coastal city in Zhejiang province famous for its overseas Chinese community. Wenzhou's tertiary hospitals have long-standing international patient services including dedicated International Medical Centres, English-speaking staff, and active liaison with US and European consulates.

cities.name: Nanning
cities.intro: Capital of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region and gateway to ASEAN countries. Several hospitals operate dedicated international departments targeted at ASEAN patients, with English/Thai/Vietnamese language services and direct billing with international insurers.
